description: Image Description: The image shows a serene beach scene with a row of surfboards neatly lined up on the sandy shore, facing the ocean. The surfboards are arranged in a slightly overlapping fashion, extending from the foreground into the midground of the image. Most of the boards are white, with a few featuring green and blue accents along their edges or logos near the nose. Each board has black fins attached to the underside, visible at the tail end.
